headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 6, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners dominated the Detroit Tigers, securing a 4-0 victory behind Bryce Miller's strong performance on the mound. In other action, the Kansas City Royals edged the Minnesota Twins 3-2, and the Chicago Cubs took down the San Francisco Giants 3-2.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with the Milwaukee Brewers placing right-handed pitcher Quinn Priester on the 60-day injured list due to right thoracic outlet syndrome. The Los Angeles Dodgers transferred right-handed pitcher Tyler Glasnow from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to low back spasms.

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their bullpen with the acquisition of right-handed reliever Joel Kuhnel from the Athletics in a trade for cash. The Brewers also made a roster move, placing left-handed pitcher Brian Fitzpatrick on the 15-day injured list due to a left elbow injury.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Out Tigers 4-0**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Detroit Tigers, securing a 4-0 victory. Bryce Miller led the way on the mound, pitching 6.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Twins in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals took down the Minnesota Twins 3-2, securing a crucial win. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in St. Louis**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a 5-6 decision to the St. Louis Cardinals in a closely contested matchup. Matt McLain led the Reds' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Giants Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs edged the San Francisco Giants 3-2, securing a narrow victory. Pete Crow-Armstrong led the Cubs' offense with 4 hits, including 2 home runs, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Brewers RHP Quinn Priester Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Quinn Priester has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to right thoracic outlet syndrome. This move marks a significant update to the team's roster.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Bullpen with Kuhnel Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have strengthened their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed reliever Joel Kuhnel, acquired from the Athletics in a trade for cash. Kuhnel joins the Brewers' roster as the team looks to solidify its bullpen for the remainder of the season.
